title: 第305章 下意识第304章 收下了
slug: 我在修仙世界成了香饽饽
content_zh:
一路穿行过长廊庭院，避开喧闹的前院待客区域，径直踏入清净雅致的后院。
后院花木错落、亭台清幽，远离前院的人来人往，静谧闲适，杨欢没有丝毫停顿，下意识朝着落云院的方向迈步。
自之前分开，席一悠那句暗藏悬念的惊喜，便一直萦绕在他心头，挥之不去。
寻常物件、寻常趣事，断然算不上惊喜，席一悠素来通透狡黠，最懂他的心思，这一句许诺，多半藏着期待许久的风月温存。
心底深处，杨欢隐隐生出几分热切的期盼。
他暗自揣测，这份惊喜，或许就是昨夜遗憾的弥补——席一悠的身子肯定是调养妥当了的，二人终于不必再克制隐忍，得以卸下所有顾虑，温存相伴、大被同眠。
这份念想浓烈且真切，并非无端贪念，皆是连日心绪层层堆积、顺势而生的结果。
自他与云韵双修之后归来，他清晰察觉到自身心境的巨变。
从前的他，步步谨慎、如履薄冰，始终心存忌惮。
因为修为浅薄，生怕被人炼化，故而克制己身，收敛所有欲望，不敢轻易动情、不敢肆意亲近身边之人。
彼时的他，敬畏人心、忌惮凶险，面对身边的女子，纵然心生悸动，也尽数压在心底，不敢逾越半分。
可如今截然不同。
他稳稳踏入三品明镜境，修为根基扎实稳固，神魂凝练纯粹，自身实力早已今非昔比。
足够的实力，便是最大的底气，从前所有的忌惮与惶恐，尽数烟消云散。
他已然拥有足够的能力护住自身，不惧任何近身算计，更不会被情欲桎梏道途。
心结一旦解开，一直压抑的本心便彻底苏醒，那些之前不敢想、不敢盼、不敢触碰的温柔风月，此刻都成了心底最真切的渴望。
加之身边环绕的皆是绝色佳人，各有风情、各有韵味。日日相伴、朝夕相对，满眼皆是温柔春色，之前压抑的欲望自然愈发浓烈，再也难以刻意克制。
尤其是昨夜那场戛然而止的温存，两人情到浓时、心意相通，却被突如其来的意外打断，那份意犹未尽的遗憾与隐忍，整整萦绕了一夜半日，让他心底始终憋着一股燥热，无从排解。
也正因如此，此刻的他，才会对席一悠口中的惊喜，生出这般直白又热切的期盼。
心绪翻涌之间，杨欢脚步悄然加快，朝着落云院的方向稳步走去。

心底已然默默做好了盘算，随性坦荡，不欺本心。
若是席一悠的惊喜，恰好如他所愿，消解昨夜遗憾，那自然是最好不过，二人便可好好温存，不负此刻风月、不负彼此心意。
若是惊喜只是寻常雅趣，无关风月，那他也不必刻意压抑自身。
林未浓尚在席府，若是未曾寻到她，便径直动身前往张府去找云韵。
修道之人，修的是本心，顺的是自然，欲望本是人之常情，无需避讳、无需克制，顺其自然，妥当排解便足矣。
心念既定，心底的躁动愈发清晰，脚步也愈发沉稳轻快，不多时便稳稳抵达落云院。
落云院素来清幽雅致，院中干净整洁，青石地面一尘不染，院中花木静立，无风无动。
此刻外院空空荡荡，没有侍女值守，静悄悄的，连细碎的脚步声、低语声都尽数消失，整座院落静谧得恰到好处，隐隐透着私密又缱绻的氛围。
杨欢驻足片刻，目光落在紧闭的卧房房门上，眼底期许更甚，抬手轻轻叩了叩木门。
敲门声轻缓落地，屋内几乎没有半分停顿，一道软糯娇媚、缱绻入骨的女声缓缓传出，嗓音慵懒沙哑，带着松弛，又藏着几分勾人的暧昧，轻轻浅浅落在门外：“进来吧……”
单单三个字，便柔得人心尖发颤，无端勾起满心旖旎。
杨欢推门而入，房门顺势轻掩，隔绝了院外所有天光与声响，屋内瞬间化作一方私密温柔的小天地。
入目之处，暖意融融，熏香淡淡的清雅气息萦绕全屋，温柔又安神。
席一悠方才正坐在案前饮茶，此刻已然缓缓起身，身姿窈窕柔婉，静静立在屋中。
她换了一身全新的衣衫，褪去了先前规整的衣裙，身着一袭通透雪白的薄纱长裙。
纱质极轻极薄，近乎虚无，通透得没有半分遮挡之力，轻飘飘覆在她玲珑有致的身躯上，贴合着每一寸肌肤的曲线。
这般半遮半掩的模样，远比全然赤裸更具风情，撩人至极。
雪白纱衣之下，峰峦起伏、腰肢纤细、双腿修长的曼妙身段尽数隐约浮现，肌理细腻、骨肉匀称，朦胧的留白感拉满韵味，每一寸轮廓都透着浑然天成的妩媚，勾得人眼底发热、心神躁动。
听闻推门动静，席一悠抬眸望来，一双潋滟水眸含着浅浅笑意，眼尾微微上挑，自带万般风情。
看清进门之人是杨欢后，她唇角的笑意愈发柔媚，眼底狡黠与温柔交织，风月尽显，不躲不避，大大方方任由他打量。

“还以为你会耽误许久，没想到你这般快就回来了……”她语气慵懒轻柔，带着几分娇俏的打趣，缓步上前半步，身姿轻摇，纱衣微动，风情流转，“方才那人是谁？可有惹什么麻烦？”
杨欢的目光牢牢锁在她曼妙的身姿上，眼底燥热渐起，心底残存的最后几分克制尽数消散，喉结微微轻滚，声音比平日里低沉沙哑几分：“道门地宗的一位前辈，寻常碰面，并无大碍……”
简单一句应答，便再无多余话语，他所有的注意力，都落在眼前这撩人的景致上。
薄纱覆身、风月暗藏，席一悠浑然不觉羞怯，反倒落落大方，任由他肆意打量，眼底的媚色愈发浓烈，像是故意撩拨，勾得杨欢心底的火苗熊熊燃烧，昨夜至今积压的燥热，瞬间翻涌不息。
见他眸光灼灼、眼神发烫，席一悠心底了然，唇角笑意更柔、更媚，故作慵懒地舒展了一下纤细的腰肢，身姿轻晃，纱衣翻飞，朦胧的曲线愈发诱人。
content_en:
Walk all the way through the promenade courtyard, avoid the noisy front yard reception area, and step directly into the clean and elegant backyard.
The backyard was full of flowers and trees, the pavilions were quiet, and it was far away from the people coming and going in the front yard. It was quiet and relaxing. Yang Huan didn't pause at all, and subconsciously stepped in the direction of Luoyun Courtyard.
Ever since they separated before, Xi Yiyou's words of surprise with hidden suspense have been lingering in his heart and he can't get rid of them.
Ordinary objects and interesting things are definitely not surprises. Xi Yiyou has always been transparent and cunning, and understands his thoughts best. This promise probably hides the long-awaited romantic tenderness.
Deep in his heart, Yang Huan felt some eager anticipation.
He secretly speculated that this surprise might be the compensation for last night's regret - Xi Yiyou's body must have been properly nursed back to health, and the two of them finally no longer had to restrain themselves and were able to let go of all worries and sleep together tenderly.
This thought is strong and real. It is not unreasonable greed. It is the result of the accumulation of emotions over the past few days and the trend.
Since he returned from dual cultivation with Yun Yun, he has clearly noticed a huge change in his state of mind.
In the past, he was cautious, walking on thin ice, always fearful.
Because of his shallow cultivation and fear of being refined by others, he restrained himself, restrained all desires, and did not dare to get emotional easily or get close to the people around him wantonly.
At that time, he was in awe of people's hearts and fearful of danger. When facing the woman around him, even though his heart was throbbing, he suppressed it in the bottom of his heart and did not dare to go beyond it.
But now it's completely different.
He has firmly stepped into the third-level mirror realm, his cultivation foundation is solid and stable, his soul is condensed and pure, and his own strength is no longer what it used to be.
Sufficient strength is the greatest confidence. All the fears and fears in the past have disappeared.
He already has enough ability to protect himself, he is not afraid of any close calculations, and he will not be shackled by lust.
Once the knot in the heart is untied, the original heart that has been suppressed will be completely awakened. Those gentle and romantic things that I didn't dare to think about, didn't dare to hope for, and didn't dare to touch before have now become the most real longings in my heart.
In addition, he is surrounded by stunning beauties, each with his or her own style and charm. Accompanying each other day by day, facing each other day and night, with tender spring scenery everywhere in sight, the previously suppressed desires naturally become more intense and can no longer be deliberately restrained.
Especially the tenderness that came to an abrupt end last night. When the two of them were deeply in love and connected with each other, they were interrupted by a sudden accident. The unfinished regret and forbearance lingered for a whole night and a half, leaving him with a burning feeling in his heart that he could not resolve.
It was precisely because of this that at this moment, he had such straightforward and eager expectations for the surprise in Xi Yiyou's mouth.
As his mind surged, Yang Huan quietly quickened his pace and walked steadily towards the direction of Luoyun Courtyard.
I have already made my plans silently in my heart, and I am open-minded and don't deceive my true heart.
If Xi Yiyou's surprise happens to be what he wishes and eliminates the regrets of last night, then it would be the best. The two of them can be affectionate and live up to the current situation and each other's feelings.
If the surprise is just ordinary elegance and has nothing to do with romance, then he does not need to deliberately suppress himself.
Lin Weinong was still in Xi Mansion. If he hadn't found her, he would have gone straight to Zhang Mansion to find Yun Yun.
Those who practice Taoism should cultivate their original minds and follow nature. Desires are human nature. There is no need to avoid taboos or restraints. It is enough to let nature take its course and resolve it properly.
With his mind set, the restlessness in his heart became clearer and clearer, his footsteps became more steady and brisk, and he arrived steadily at Luoyun Courtyard in a short time.
Luoyun Courtyard has always been quiet and elegant. The courtyard is clean and tidy, the bluestone floor is spotless, and the flowers and trees in the courtyard stand quietly without any movement in the wind.
At this moment, the outer courtyard was empty, with no maids on duty, and it was quiet. Even the sounds of footsteps and whispers had disappeared. The entire courtyard was perfectly quiet, with a vaguely private and affectionate atmosphere.
Yang Huan paused for a moment, his eyes fell on the closed bedroom door, his eyes were even more hopeful, he raised his hand and knocked gentlyKnocked on the wooden door.
There was a gentle knock on the door, and there was almost no pause in the house. A soft, charming, and affectionate female voice slowly came out. Her voice was lazy and hoarse, with a hint of relaxation, and it also contained a bit of seductive ambiguity. She gently landed outside the door: "Come in..."
Just three words can make people's hearts tremble, and arouse their heart's charm for no reason.
Yang Huan pushed the door open and walked in. The door was gently closed, blocking out all the light and sound outside the courtyard. The room instantly turned into a private and gentle little world.
Wherever you enter, you feel warm and cozy, and the light and elegant scent of incense lingers throughout the house, gentle and soothing.
Xi Yiyou was sitting in front of the table drinking tea just now. At this moment, he slowly stood up and stood quietly in the room with a graceful and graceful figure.
She changed into a new set of clothes, took off her previous regular dress, and wore a transparent snow-white tulle dress.
The gauze was extremely light and thin, almost nothing, so transparent that it had no blocking power. It floated lightly on her exquisite body, conforming to the curves of every inch of her skin.
Such a half-covered appearance is far more charming and extremely sultry than being completely naked.
Under the snow-white gauze, the graceful figure with undulating peaks, slender waist, and slender legs is vaguely revealed. The texture is delicate, the bones are well-proportioned, and the hazy blankness is full of charm. Every inch of the outline is full of natural charm, which makes people's eyes warm and their hearts are restless.
Hearing the sound of opening the door, Xi Yiyou raised his eyes and looked up. He saw a pair of watery eyes with a slight smile, and the ends of his eyes were slightly raised, with all kinds of charm.
After she saw clearly that the person entering the door was Yang Huan, the smile on her lips became softer and more charming. Her eyes were cunning and gentle, showing off her charm. She didn't hide or avoid it, and she let him look at her openly.
"I thought you would be delayed for a long time, but I didn't expect you to come back so soon..." She said in a lazy and soft tone, with a bit of coquettish teasing, and slowly took half a step forward. She swayed slightly, her gauze clothes moved slightly, and her charm was flowing, "Who was that person just now? Did he cause any trouble?"
Yang Huan's eyes were firmly locked on her graceful figure. The heat in his eyes gradually grew, and the last few remaining restraints in his heart dissipated. His Adam's apple rolled slightly, and his voice was a little lower and hoarse than usual: "A senior of the Dao Sect Earth Sect, we met normally, nothing serious..."
With a simple reply, there were no more unnecessary words. All his attention fell on the sultry scenery in front of him.
Covered by gauze and hidden by the wind and moon, Xi Yiyou didn't feel shy at all. Instead, she was generous and allowed him to look at her arbitrarily. The charming look in her eyes became more and more intense, as if she was deliberately teasing her, which made the fire in Yang Huan's heart burn brightly. The heat accumulated from last night until now surged in an instant.
Seeing his scorching eyes, Xi Yiyou understood in her heart, and the smile on her lips became softer and more charming. She pretended to lazily stretch her slender waist, her body swayed slightly, her gauze clothes flew, and her hazy curves became more and more attractive.
